note: Five Upgrade Roadmap 2 waste, soil and sanitation systems. Existing workbook numbers are unchanged. Reference quantities and game assumptions are distinguished in row notes. Laundry Station is tagged Sanitation rather than Water-System, which is at its 20-system target.

systems.name: Manure Windrow
systems.description: Turn livestock manure and carbon bedding into finished compost.
systems.notes: 30 lb Manure + 15 lb Carbon + 10 gal Water + 1 h turning per week -> 25 lb Compost; the 20 lb mass difference is water and carbon lost while composting. Carbon is needed to balance nitrogen-rich manure. Ratios, losses and labor are experimental game balance.

systems.name: Leaf Litter Gathering
systems.description: Rake and bag fallen leaves and litter as carbon for toilets and compost.
systems.notes: 1.5 h/week raking and hauling -> 30 lb Carbon; buy covers rakes and tarps. Spread evenly over the year (stored bags); a seasonal leaf-fall model is not included. Yield and labor are experimental game balance.

systems.name: Sawmill Sawdust Pickup
systems.description: Buy bulk sawdust from a local sawmill as carbon cover material.
systems.notes: $6/week + 0.25 h unloading -> 100 lb Carbon (sawdust or shavings). Price and haul abstraction are experimental game balance; untreated wood only.

systems.name: Cover Crop Seeding
systems.description: Sow a winter cover crop on nearby beds after harvest to rebuild their soil.
systems.notes: 2 oz Seeds per season + 0.1 h/week sows about 200 sq ft of garden within 30 ft; while beds rest, it adds up to 0.15 LL-35 fertility a year, shared by garden area. Seed rate, coverage and gain are experimental game balance.

systems.name: Laundry Station
systems.description: A washtub, wringer and line for washing clothes by hand with hot water.
systems.notes: 30 gal Water + 20 gal Hot water + 2 h/week -> 5 Wellbeing and 45 gal Greywater (5 gal carried off in wet clothes and evaporation). Quantities are experimental game balance for a small household's hand laundry.
